description.en: ship full apps by describing what you want — no CS degree required
description.zh: 用自然语言描述需求，直接交付完整 app，无需计算机背景

goal.zh: 用描述代替编程，直接交付 app

outcome.en: Turn product ideas into working apps without a CS degree. Describe what you want in plain language — your agent scaffolds the project, writes the code, wires up APIs, and iterates on your feedback. Vibe coding at its best: you stay in the creative loop, the agent handles the implementation.
outcome.zh: 无需计算机背景，把产品想法变成可用的 app。用自然语言描述需求——你的 Agent 搭建项目结构、编写代码、接入 API，并根据你的反馈迭代。Vibe 编程的核心：你负责创意和方向，Agent 负责实现。

reason.en: Your coding co-pilot — scaffold projects, write features, run tests, and fix bugs on command. You describe the outcome; the agent writes the code.
reason.zh: 你的编程副驾——搭建项目、编写功能、运行测试、修复 bug，全部按需执行。你描述目标，Agent 写代码。

en: Build a landing page for my SaaS idea
Add user authentication to this app
Fix the bug where the form doesn't submit
zh: 为我的 SaaS 想法构建一个落地页
给这个 app 加上用户认证
修复表单提交失败的 bug

reason.en: Supercharge Cursor with agent-native workflows — multi-file edits, context-aware refactors, and tab completions that understand your whole codebase.
reason.zh: 用 Agent 原生工作流强化 Cursor——多文件编辑、上下文感知重构，以及理解整个代码库的智能补全。

en: Refactor this component across all my files
Generate a full CRUD API from this schema
Explain what this codebase does and where to start
zh: 重构这个组件并更新所有相关文件
根据这个 schema 生成完整的 CRUD API
解释这个代码库的功能和入手位置

reason.en: When your app needs AI inside — add Claude-powered features like summarization, Q&A, or generation without becoming an ML engineer.
reason.zh: 当你的 app 需要内置 AI——添加 Claude 驱动的功能，如摘要、问答或生成，无需成为 ML 工程师。

en: Add an AI chat feature to my app
Generate personalized content for each user
zh: 给我的 app 添加 AI 对话功能
自动摘要用户提交内容
为每个用户生成个性化内容
